title: Lumerical FDTD simulation spec
description: Units are SI. Lengths and wavelengths are metres. simulation time is seconds. Property names match the Lumerical GUI; underscores are converted to spaces. The GUI stays hidden unless hide_gui is false. A source project is copied into the runs directory and is not overwritten. transmission exports pass only the monitor name; with more than one source, Lumerical normalizes that result to the total source power.

setup_only.description: Save the project and do not launch the solver.

project.description: Existing .fsp to open. Omit to create a new simulation.

run_root.description: Directory that receives runs/<timestamp>_<name>/. Overrides LUMERICAL_FDTD_RUNS.

global_source.description: Arguments to setglobalsource. Wavelengths are metres.

simulation.description: Properties of the FDTD region. Created when project is omitted. Examples: dimension, x span, mesh accuracy, simulation time, x min bc.

op.description: Lumerical constructor such as addrect, addmode, addpower, addprofile, or addmesh.

overrides.description: setnamed calls for objects already in the project.

script.description: Lumerical script evaluated after the structured fields.

script_file.description: Script file. Relative paths are resolved next to the spec file on the CLI. fdtd_run requires an existing absolute path.

source.description: Recorded for the caller. The solver transmission function in this plugin receives only the monitor name.
